hinge_axis_review: The two source animated hinge barrels are circular, centered at inspected x=0.69588 m and z=0.05341 m, and separated vertically. Their radius extends 18.1 mm beyond the measured axis after 0.70 scale, so the generic outer-edge proxy fails although the axis crosses both barrels. Use the unchanged 10 mm axis-to-barrel-center check; retain all hinge collisions.
modifications: Uniform 0.70 scale of the inspected Y-up meter geometry, giving a roughly 2.0 m leaf.
Proper cyclic rotation to canonical Z-up; original right-side visible hinge maps to positive canonical Y and left-handed push.

Use the source USDZ zero animation pose, in which the leaf is closed inside the separate frame. Keep original frame, leaf, strike-side plate, lever plates and hinge hardware as visuals and collisions.

Infer the ideal revolute axis from the centers of the two visible moving hinge barrels; the original animation is not the B1 control path. No standalone latch bolt is identified for collision exclusion.

Partition the fixed U-frame collider at its measured rear/rebate, narrow jamb and opening-head/sill planes; retain all original frame surfaces and collisions. Declare the narrowest source aperture with a 0.5 mm inward review margin.

Uniform 2% fit of Panel and Handle around the measured hinge depth, opening center and mid-height, then rigidly shift both 18 mm toward the opening face to clear the source rebate/hinge interference. Recompute leaf dimensions, aperture and joint axis; no source mesh is deleted or collision excluded.

Use one convex leaf collider for component 5: default cooking in attempt 000006 omitted 4-6 mm of the outer door skin, violating the 2 mm visual/collision bound. The envelope fills the two decorative glazed recesses but retains full leaf contact and visual meshes.
review_notes: Component 5 is the leaf; 9 is the fixed full frame and 10 the fixed strike-side plate. Components 6-8 are moving hinge hardware, 0 is moving lock-edge plate; 1-4 are paired handles and escutcheons.
No moving scale/translation, collider partition, latch exclusion or hinge pair filter is introduced before a demonstrated issue.

Frame component 9 has a rear narrow opening at source width x=±0.650884 m and a wider front rebate at x=±0.689719 m. Attempt 000004 cut exactly on the common source-depth plane and placed rear-face vertices into front cooked hulls; the frame cut is 0.5 mm inside the front side of that plane to keep rear surfaces in the rear partition while preserving all original faces.
The original source has no separate latch bolt: moving edge plate 0 and fixed strike plate 10 retain their colliders. Full leaf/frame contact also remains active.
The leaf convex envelope is a collision approximation for push contact, not a material edit or a claim that the glass openings are solid panels.
clearance_review: Attempt 000005 has four cooked leaf/frame corner overlaps inside the sloped rebate plus proper original-surface crossings between moving hinge cylinders 6-8 and fixed jamb 9. The front opening is wider than the rear but the source leaf is too large/deep at its closed pose. A uniform 2% moving-assembly fit about the original hinge-depth and opening center, followed by an 18 mm outward normal shift, is a documented graphics-model clearance repair. Direct closed-hull evaluation leaves hinge/frame overlaps at 15 mm, while 18 mm clears every pair; the next normalization and GPU checks must confirm the sweep and stability. Frame, leaf, strike plate, hinges and handles all retain collision.
